title: German visitors record Sal for Berendt's Jazz Life
summary: Sal tells how Berendt grabbed him to fill in for Monk and he never received the tapes or magazine; the interviewer offers to get him the book.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: The fun of how it happened, I was over there trying to park my car and Joe was outside, said to me, man, you're just the right guy. You came in town. You're just at St. Paul Reigns, see? Right. Everybody's here, you. So you take monks' place, see? Oh, yeah. But all the bands ready to go, see? So I got them to start playing and they made some tapes and all and the pictures… But I never did get any tapes or anything, see? Well, I don't know if they ever sent them back or anything. Maybe Joe's gone. Maybe Raymond knows.

Well, I'll tell you how to get the book, I can give you the address. Give me a call at work and I'll give you the address of the people that put the book out. You know what I'm saying? I don't know. I don't know. I don't know if they ever sent them back or anything. I don't know if they ever sent them back or anything. Maybe Joe's gone. Maybe Raymond knows. You know, I might have to write it up and mail it to you. You don't speak German, I imagine. No, Spanish.
